finding: The originally proposed C2A slice is not dependency-closed against canonical main. Several PostgreSQL adapters import earlier Bybit Demo trade-management or strategy-coupled domain modules that are absent on main. Wholesale extraction would therefore reintroduce hidden research/operational ancestry.

dependency_classification.reason: Lease dataclass/file semantics are independent of strategy, broker network, ranking, PnL and order submission.
Implements singleton durable lease only; explicitly has order_writes_supported=false and no automatic stale takeover.
Checkpoint persistence is required later, but its current typed state is coupled to active trade management and strategy plan types. It must not be smuggled into the first infrastructure slice.
The durable store is safe itself, but its typed authorization record/builder depends on operator-approval/review-row semantics that must be canonicalized independently first.
Current provenance object is built from strategy selection/fallback/cycle outputs and therefore is not a dependency-safe C2 foundation primitive.
Terminal evidence belongs after reconciled active-trade lifecycle/accounting contracts, not in the first lease-infrastructure slice.

historical_migrations.note: Must remain byte-identical if preserved as historical lineage. It creates both lease and active-excursion tables; first-slice code may use only the lease table while the checkpoint adapter remains deferred.
Defer until approval/provenance/terminal domain contracts are separated and issue #107 defines forward no-TRUNCATE/least-privilege hardening. Do not edit this frozen migration in place.

revised_first_executable_slice.name: STRATEGY_FREE_DURABLE_RUNTIME_LEASE_FOUNDATION
revised_first_executable_slice.test_scope_rule: Extract only runtime-lease tests from the mixed historical test module; do not pull excursion/strategy fixtures into C2A0.
required_behavior: single writer across independent PostgreSQL store instances
no TTL or automatic stale takeover
inspect returns exact durable owner identity
orphaned durable row blocks later acquire regardless of clock age
v119 migration applies deterministically on PostgreSQL 16
